new: Eight more stories moved into story packages: the qubits, the mutation machine, the flock, the tutorial, the endotypes, the PET story, the aging ovary and the soil story.
Each one is the same story as before, with the same link, the same place on the Stories screen and the same miniature at its station in a shared room.
Their narrations now live in their own folders, so a headset downloads each one again the first time it plays.
test: Open each of the eight from the Stories screen on a laptop and in a headset: it should load, play with its narration and open explore mode.
Check the tutorial is still the last card and that a plain start (no story in the address) still opens the airports, not the tutorial.
In a shared room, place the flock and the soil story as stations: each should show its usual miniature, and a second headset should follow.
With Take all stories done, go offline and open two of the moved stories.
untested: The moved stories in a real headset session, their narration there, and a shared room of several headsets.
How the new narration downloads behave on a slow network at an event.
